title: Einleitung
author: Walther von Dyck
full_title: Nova Kepleriana: Wieder aufgefundene Drucke und Handschriften von Johannes Kepler, 4: Die Keplerbriefe auf der Nationalbibliothek und auf der Sternwarte in Paris
summary: The history of Philipp Müller's correspondence, bought by Joseph-Nicolas Delisle in 1736, partly stolen from the Paris Observatory by Guglielmo Libri and bought back from the Ashburnham library in 1888, with a list of every letter in it and of which survive.
